The mechanism likely involves the compound modulating the activity of PI-PLC X domain-containing protein 3, potentially through a direct or indirect interaction that affects the expression or function of CD37. The evidence supports a role for the compound in the regulation of CD37, possibly through a signaling cascade involving the PI-PLC X domain-containing protein 3.
